[Highlight start] **Vomiting blood (hematemesis) after drinking requires prompt medical evaluation** [Highlight end] **.** Call **911** or go to the nearest emergency room right away if the bleeding is heavy or accompanied by warning signs.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5grzwsfb4qyLdpQAZKiAxPDjV17bfStdWAwL24Td0ih7rCedIfBYf8oyQtZ2_Fv7Ju6xidSIFfZckcpNC_6RwR8468ru1I_PpMcyxrgCNxmE6VME-DTA7Ah63r1RmZFP7JDgsP2c1sbCMENV-Zc3x6n2vQmuCvk97w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX4ifRoN0MsbWNbKYAssu8U-KKFD3569QlXC__P5SHqTANlwVmKHVQBFcLRRipMzQS4eh5EU2QpLeU0sGlHgg3Rp3vpWqBwzHKsY3EMZn5v3l7WY5n8Fiqti4gFTMQU-d4VxeE9nQsNy7ocGhFclSmLKFh2U3IwBo_Pg)

### When to Seek Emergency Care (Call 911)

Get immediate emergency help if you or someone else has any of these signs:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX4ifRoN0MsbWNbKYAssu8U-KKFD3569QlXC__P5SHqTANlwVmKHVQBFcLRRipMzQS4eh5EU2QpLeU0sGlHgg3Rp3vpWqBwzHKsY3EMZn5v3l7WY5n8Fiqti4gFTMQU-d4VxeE9nQsNy7ocGhFclSmLKFh2U3IwBo_Pg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5grzwsfb4qyLdpQAZKiAxPDjV17bfStdWAwL24Td0ih7rCedIfBYf8oyQtZ2_Fv7Ju6xidSIFfZckcpNC_6RwR8468ru1I_PpMcyxrgCNxmE6VME-DTA7Ah63r1RmZFP7JDgsP2c1sbCMENV-Zc3x6n2vQmuCvk97w)

- Large amounts of bright red blood or dark, lumpy "coffee ground" vomit
- Dizziness, lightheadedness, confusion, or fainting
- Pale, cold, or clammy skin, or rapid/shallow breathing
- Severe abdominal or chest pain
- Black, tarry, or bloody stools
- Signs of alcohol poisoning, such as unresponsiveness, slow breathing, or seizures[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXbF9_a8tCX30ZRwQ-8SB5d4Y5SE0yLZBBXeDZeF_0EZjLRVdz8ClTzsnlIB9J2Mksu-lU6_6RdKV6cw-f0bWpIR_ZPoGlTW2qbxFjHyFaJO-bCgM5_TQOyXTlGaICoqyI6-6RpE6Gg4S-A1i35VgH2EdKt5ol1G93)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF19ezvXXeN0VgD6UrBwcPMptdDY3kvJFBing94zS42qIQdPBSdmdZDVWvYoa5AcAjm-h8pwxBUhe45nCKrdDLZA8Uu_uX2u30_JQjdTWAVuMwXAXF_ivqoZcS_NWNPw8VLF8HHXqww-LhlbBAMol9cw4SkX2ppLSuK4GwwVM57cS4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5grzwsfb4qyLdpQAZKiAxPDjV17bfStdWAwL24Td0ih7rCedIfBYf8oyQtZ2_Fv7Ju6xidSIFfZckcpNC_6RwR8468ru1I_PpMcyxrgCNxmE6VME-DTA7Ah63r1RmZFP7JDgsP2c1sbCMENV-Zc3x6n2vQmuCvk97w)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXAvBbGN9ey8nwUal_hkHEyBg3lmQtEzgz2kXf5Lue4mMsrRh4ho9Gb2Ub1O03l5SFgxomdc2K2WVup4rcKH1LY-oI7zybT787bPL9VotJ1nCDSR-F0Je-SEj5B8W1bXDCvw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1-6loEYGM71zxrpP5_4cH7yzDKrssvJtVZ7EojvBkwXuaP82pyaybX2dy27gv6qSAN7Sx-Hbig6sScQ1XegoId2tDMHdGQfMIuvBa2Z02G4iNRC1aZxijxcMqY9cBgmWs201ccpQC0nLGhxOx8tLEkaoFsLxzxJ39hm_kX8TIonzkOSNnNI1H-QnEEINgZtltip9pHJBV8Ll3fx1)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1w2sOKcI-3eVsKtzqUuvlk8_XktF9OVo6KkNQSrAEBUmwDH19vXonG7YAIlid1ShUbDxfaFdSE2FkQ5qgsUEmnSZ_aehCxneer8x8IeiO6-A_FxmnRqmZn384g0hQ6KY-SrMMtYjCGLY31E0gBnW6pxtKv6LdEP24UQVxbu1vdi0KI_E8wZ9)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXE9aC1bXR4mzI5cxAeQlVMEFifpfpEcJnx57QpfsbzGD58KIKga0hCuHvIFZNzX77H6ZIPb5RX86W4o0WUPqwkVxOWE2Gm5jbFmISsgX6HmZY9m02thA8alWtnu8nDlMp)

Even if there is only a small streak of blood, you should still contact a doctor so they can rule out an underlying issue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXbF9_a8tCX30ZRwQ-8SB5d4Y5SE0yLZBBXeDZeF_0EZjLRVdz8ClTzsnlIB9J2Mksu-lU6_6RdKV6cw-f0bWpIR_ZPoGlTW2qbxFjHyFaJO-bCgM5_TQOyXTlGaICoqyI6-6RpE6Gg4S-A1i35VgH2EdKt5ol1G93)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5grzwsfb4qyLdpQAZKiAxPDjV17bfStdWAwL24Td0ih7rCedIfBYf8oyQtZ2_Fv7Ju6xidSIFfZckcpNC_6RwR8468ru1I_PpMcyxrgCNxmE6VME-DTA7Ah63r1RmZFP7JDgsP2c1sbCMENV-Zc3x6n2vQmuCvk97w)

### Immediate Steps While Waiting for Help

- **Stay upright or on your side:** Sit upright or lie on your side to help protect your airway and reduce choking risk.
- **Do not eat or drink:** Avoid food, liquids, alcohol, and pain relievers like ibuprofen or aspirin.
- **Do not drive yourself:** Have someone else drive you or wait for emergency services.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF19ezvXXeN0VgD6UrBwcPMptdDY3kvJFBing94zS42qIQdPBSdmdZDVWvYoa5AcAjm-h8pwxBUhe45nCKrdDLZA8Uu_uX2u30_JQjdTWAVuMwXAXF_ivqoZcS_NWNPw8VLF8HHXqww-LhlbBAMol9cw4SkX2ppLSuK4GwwVM57cS4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX4ifRoN0MsbWNbKYAssu8U-KKFD3569QlXC__P5SHqTANlwVmKHVQBFcLRRipMzQS4eh5EU2QpLeU0sGlHgg3Rp3vpWqBwzHKsY3EMZn5v3l7WY5n8Fiqti4gFTMQU-d4VxeE9nQsNy7ocGhFclSmLKFh2U3IwBo_Pg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXE9aC1bXR4mzI5cxAeQlVMEFifpfpEcJnx57QpfsbzGD58KIKga0hCuHvIFZNzX77H6ZIPb5RX86W4o0WUPqwkVxOWE2Gm5jbFmISsgX6HmZY9m02thA8alWtnu8nDlMp)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXAvBbGN9ey8nwUal_hkHEyBg3lmQtEzgz2kXf5Lue4mMsrRh4ho9Gb2Ub1O03l5SFgxomdc2K2WVup4rcKH1LY-oI7zybT787bPL9VotJ1nCDSR-F0Je-SEj5B8W1bXDCvw)

### Common Causes After Drinking
Alcohol can irritate or damage the upper digestive tract (esophagus, stomach, and upper small intestine) in several ways:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXbF9_a8tCX30ZRwQ-8SB5d4Y5SE0yLZBBXeDZeF_0EZjLRVdz8ClTzsnlIB9J2Mksu-lU6_6RdKV6cw-f0bWpIR_ZPoGlTW2qbxFjHyFaJO-bCgM5_TQOyXTlGaICoqyI6-6RpE6Gg4S-A1i35VgH2EdKt5ol1G93)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5grzwsfb4qyLdpQAZKiAxPDjV17bfStdWAwL24Td0ih7rCedIfBYf8oyQtZ2_Fv7Ju6xidSIFfZckcpNC_6RwR8468ru1I_PpMcyxrgCNxmE6VME-DTA7Ah63r1RmZFP7JDgsP2c1sbCMENV-Zc3x6n2vQmuCvk97w)

- **Throat or esophageal tears (Mallory-Weiss tears):** Forceful retching or vomiting can create small tears that bleed.
- **Gastritis:** Alcohol can inflame and erode the stomach lining.
- **Peptic ulcers:** Sores in the stomach or upper intestine can bleed.
- **Esophageal varices:** Liver damage from heavy drinking can cause swollen veins in the esophagus that can rupture and bleed heavily.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXbF9_a8tCX30ZRwQ-8SB5d4Y5SE0yLZBBXeDZeF_0EZjLRVdz8ClTzsnlIB9J2Mksu-lU6_6RdKV6cw-f0bWpIR_ZPoGlTW2qbxFjHyFaJO-bCgM5_TQOyXTlGaICoqyI6-6RpE6Gg4S-A1i35VgH2EdKt5ol1G93)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX4ifRoN0MsbWNbKYAssu8U-KKFD3569QlXC__P5SHqTANlwVmKHVQBFcLRRipMzQS4eh5EU2QpLeU0sGlHgg3Rp3vpWqBwzHKsY3EMZn5v3l7WY5n8Fiqti4gFTMQU-d4VxeE9nQsNy7ocGhFclSmLKFh2U3IwBo_Pg)

You can read more about symptoms and evaluation in this [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5grzwsfb4qyLdpQAZKiAxPDjV17bfStdWAwL24Td0ih7rCedIfBYf8oyQtZ2_Fv7Ju6xidSIFfZckcpNC_6RwR8468ru1I_PpMcyxrgCNxmE6VME-DTA7Ah63r1RmZFP7JDgsP2c1sbCMENV-Zc3x6n2vQmuCvk97w) guide on vomiting blood.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5grzwsfb4qyLdpQAZKiAxPDjV17bfStdWAwL24Td0ih7rCedIfBYf8oyQtZ2_Fv7Ju6xidSIFfZckcpNC_6RwR8468ru1I_PpMcyxrgCNxmE6VME-DTA7Ah63r1RmZFP7JDgsP2c1sbCMENV-Zc3x6n2vQmuCvk97w)If you are asking for yourself or someone else right now, sharing **how much blood** appeared, **what color** it was, and **any other symptoms** (like dizziness or abdominal pain) can help me provide more relevant information.
